assets/images/animals/bird_real.webp.author: David Raju (photograph); Paolo Villa (transparent crop, alpha and color correction)
assets/images/animals/bird_real.webp.changes: Used Paolo Villa’s existing transparent derivative, which includes a color correction that makes the belly appear lighter than in David Raju’s original JPEG. The derivative alpha was retained; alpha-bound crop, aspect-preserving Lanczos resampling to a 900 px maximum extent, centered 1024x1024 RGBA export and 4 px white outer outline were applied. No further RGB edits, background reconstruction, or generative processing; RGB resampling occurred during resize. Adaptation shared under CC BY-SA 4.0.
assets/images/animals/bird_real.webp.humanContentReviewPending: Technical photo review accepted; final human approval of this bird photo for the generic “Kuş” / “Bird” labels remains pending.

assets/images/animals/fish_real.webp.author: Ellicrum (transparent derivative); original photograph by Ffish.asia
assets/images/animals/fish_real.webp.changes: Generic fish image (not labeled as a goldfish). The existing transparent derivative by Ellicrum incorporates the original photograph by Ffish.asia. Its existing alpha was preserved; alpha-bound crop, aspect-preserving resize to a 912 px maximum extent, centered 1024x1024 RGBA export, and a 4 px white outer outline were applied. No background-removal or generative edits. The adapted PNG is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution to both creators and links to the source and licenses.

assets/images/animals/turtle_real.webp.author: Katrin Bolovtsova
assets/images/animals/turtle_real.webp.changes: Single complete photographed Red-Eared Slider turtle on a plain background. Classical OpenCV GrabCut used a reviewed source contour, central-shell and visible-head/forelimb foreground seeds, and background seeds (5 iterations at 1800x1200). Original RGB detail retained without repainting; aspect-preserving resize and centering on a 1024x1024 RGBA canvas, with a 4 px white outer outline. Rear limbs and tail are naturally tucked beneath the shell in the original photograph. No generative edits.
